GHA.note: Page states nothing on rules or an authority against AI harms.
Page states nothing on government use of AI.
Page states nothing on AI in a public sector system.
Page states nothing on AI models, datasets or computing built in the country.
Page names no Ghanaian data protection law, authority, regulation or application.

facts.fact: The University of Ghana School of Law lists a project, the Africa Centre of Excellence on Data Governance and Digital Rights, running from 2024 to present, to promote research, capacity building and publications on data governance and digital rights, including AI and cyber security.
